# pangolin_domain (Data Source)

Look up an existing domain by org_id and domain_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_domain" "example" {
  org_id    = "acme"
  domain_id = "d1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String)
- `org_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `base_domain` (String)
- `cert_resolver` (String)
- `prefer_wildcard_cert` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
- `verified` (Boolean)
